title: Duplicate Payment Transactions
business_scenario: Customer retries payment after a network glitch or timeout, or resubmits the payment form.
symptoms: Multiple successful payment records and transaction charges are created for the same order.
reproduction_steps: Place an order in PENDING_PAYMENT status.
Call POST /api/payments/process again with the same order ID.
Inspect the database payments list for duplicate SUCCESS transactions.
expected_behavior: An order must only be settled once. Subsequent payment requests for an already paid order must be rejected or recognized as duplicate.
actual_behavior: Payment processing creates another SUCCESS transaction record each time it is called.
root_cause: payments.service.js does not verify whether an order has already achieved SUCCESS status before creating a new payment record.
acceptance_criteria: Calling processPayment on an already settled order must throw an error or return duplicate=true without adding a new successful charge.
reference_fix: Query existing payments for the orderId and check if any have status === 'SUCCESS'. If so, reject duplicate payment attempts.
regression_tests: Failed payment can be legitimately retried once.
